d. To enlist the assistance of appropriate
government agencies and entities and local governments
for the transmission and implementation of policies,
programs and/or reforms which are calculated to de-
velop a strong and dynamic moral character, integrity
and civic consciousness among the masses of our people.
Me. To investigate cases of graft and corrup-
tion and violations of Republic Acts Nos. 1379 and
3019, and gather necessary evidence to establish, pri-
ma facie, acts of graft and acquisition of unlawfully
amassed wealth and, for the purpose, it shall have
access, inter alia, to the records of the Presidential
Anti-Graft Committee created by Executive Order Ho..
378 dated February 18, 1960, and abolished by Execu-
tive Order No.
457 dated December 20,
now in the custody of the National Bureau of Investi-
"F. To make and submit a regular report on
the overall conduct and performance on reforms and
remedies intended to improve the administration of
government or its essential services and operations.
is. To conduct seminars and educational can-
paigns in government offices and, whenever possible,
in communities for the purpose of instilling the pro-
per sense of spiritual and moral values as the foun-
dation of an enduring national vitality, strensth
and character.
"h. To receive and evaluate, and to conduct
factfinding investigations of, sworn complaints against
the acts, conduct or behavior of any public official
or employee and to file and prosecute the proper char-
res with the appropriate agency.
Other complaints
shall be investigatod, regardless of form, so long as
they are signed,
Hoover, it shall have no jurisdic-
tion over private persons or entities, unless there
is evidence of collusion between tho private indivi-
dual and the public official or employee and the matter
under investigation is within the official functions
of the latter, , or except when the private citizen is
a former public official whose actuationg as such are
the subject of inquiry,
Cases shall be disposed of
181
within ninety (90) days from receipt.
Mi. To perform such other duties and functions
as the President of the Philippines may from time
to time direct."
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th dey of
Septomber, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-seven.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
Prosident of the Philippines
By the Fresident:
(SGD.) RAFAEL M. SALAS
Executive Secretary
